Description: Lead scoring from real engagement signals with reasons: replies, response time, enquiry completeness, job value and recency, so scores spread instead of clustering

Definition of Done: On production 79 of 156 leads (51%) share the score 38, so the score cannot rank anyone. This row finds why (the constant must be traced to its cause and removed, not capped) and replaces the inputs with signals that exist: inbound replies and their count, how fast the lead replies and how fast the business replied (from synced mail, MVP-011), enquiry completeness (how many of the IFC-333 fields are present), job value (a budget the lead stated, or the price range of the matched service once IFC-334 settings exist), recency of the last inbound and open or click engagement (lead-email-engagement.ts). Each score is stored with 2 to 4 reasons that name the real signals and values ("replied twice, last reply 1 day ago", "no postcode or budget given"); a signal that is missing lowers confidence and is listed as missing, it never counts as zero or as a default. The model may read free text to judge it but the number is computed from the signals, and a lead with no signals shows "not enough information" rather than a score. Maps to the Lead Scoring Dashboard (PG-148, Completed, reuse its distribution view) and the AI scoring chain (IFC-005, IFC-212). Evidence on the owner tenant (production, real leads): the score distribution before and after as two tables in owner-tenant-measurement.md; targets: no single score value holds more than 15% of leads (today 51%), at least 5 of 10 score bands populated, every score has at least 1 reason, 0 scores without stored inputs; back-check against outcome: over every lead the tenant has marked won or lost (n stated), the won rate of the top third by score is higher than that of the bottom third; if fewer than 20 leads are closed the evidence says inconclusive with n and the row is not claimed as validated on outcome. Cost per scoring run reported from chain_runs (today 985 runs, $0.37 total, so a spread is not bought with spend)
KPIs: No score value >15% of leads (today 51% at 38), >=5 of 10 bands populated, every score has >=1 reason from real signals, top-third won rate > bottom-third won rate (n stated, inconclusive if n<20)
